# AK40-10 V3.0 KV170 reference files

Retrieved Oct 31, 2026 from CubeMars, unchanged. The STEP is identical to the earlier copy in cad/v2/vendor.

- Product: https://www.cubemars.com/product/ak40-10-v3-0-kv170-robotic-actuator.html
- Drawing PDF: https://www.cubemars.com/data/cms/202607/ak40-10-v3-0-kv170-2d-drawing.pdf
- Drawing image: https://www.cubemars.com/images/202607/AK40-10-V3.0-KV170-en-draw.png
- STEP archive: https://www.cubemars.com/data/cms/202607/ak40-10-v3-0-kv170-3d-drawing.zip

The maker STEP contains open shells. The assembly uses vendor.ak40_10() for solid collision checks: Ø53 × 40.2, Ø37 rotating flange, 3 × M2.5 on PCD27 (3 mm deep), rear 4 × M2.5 on PCD47 (5 mm deep). No Ø15 pilot fit is assumed. Envelope does not certify connector / lead bend / cooling clearance; bench VERIFY.
